analysis.rationale: R0 pipeline confirmed at mechanism level, not just by signal verdicts: 90-91% of channel values are bit-exact equal to clean, and every changed channel is exactly 0 or 255 in ~50:50 salt/pepper with per-channel independent masks. x_distortion noise_impulse amount map = [0.01,0.03,0.05,0.07,0.10]; observed amount = 0.100 -> sev5. sev4 (0.07) simulated changed=6.998% vs target 9.998% -> rejected (verify_signals WEAK, sigma diff 33%). Any global/blur/JPEG step is physically excluded: each would alter nearly all channel values, contradicting 90% bit-exact unchanged; cross-category controls (saturate_strengthen_HSV:2 changes 63.3% of channels, compression_jpeg:2 changes 92.2%) both MISMATCH. The apparent global signals (variance_ratio 1.1884-1.6082, mean_shift -0.0058~+0.0312, chroma 2.17-5.09, clipped 0.10-0.35) are fully reproduced by pure impulse simulation to 3 decimals -> outlier artifacts of the sparse replacement, not independent degradations. Per SKILL, a noise step is never LIKELY -> UNCERTAIN. No candidate improved over the R0 control (MATCH already maximal) -> NO_CHANGE.
